purpose: Software and programming through versioned design, code, tests, standards, maintenance, user impact, and reproducible claims.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name product, version, platform, and workload. Reproduce measurements under stated conditions, check current advisories, and omit exploitable security procedures and private user data.
